title: Welcome
headline: Plans with the people you know.
tagline: Invite friends to dinners, trips and game nights, see who’s coming and talk it over. No ads, and no feed that decides for you.
eventsBody: Invite people, answer in one tap, and see who’s coming.
messagesBody: Chats with friends and groups, with notifications only for what you ask for.
leafletsBody: Short notes to friends and followers: a question, a tip, something to lend.
